description: This file defines a set of converter classes for numerical types, facilitating conversions between different number representations and to/from strings, with locale and formatting considerations. It includes various converter implementations such as BigDecimal, BigInteger, Double, Float, Integer, Long, Short, and Byte, along with utility methods for parsing and formatting numbers.

classes.name: NumberConverters
classes.description: Main class providing methods to load and register various number converter implementations.

classes.name: AbstractStringToNumberConverter
classes.description: Abstract class for converting from String to a Number type, handling locale-specific parsing.

classes.name: AbstractNumberConverter
classes.description: Abstract class for converting from a source type to a target type, with locale and format support.

classes.name: AbstractNumberToStringConverter
classes.description: Abstract class for converting from a Number to String, with locale-specific formatting.

classes.name: GenericNumberToDouble
classes.description: Converter for transforming any Number subtype to Double.

classes.name: GenericNumberToFloat
classes.description: Converter for transforming any Number subtype to Float.

classes.name: GenericNumberToInteger
classes.description: Converter for transforming any Number subtype to Integer.

classes.name: GenericNumberToLong
classes.description: Converter for transforming any Number subtype to Long.

classes.name: GenericNumberToShort
classes.description: Converter for transforming any Number subtype to Short.

classes.name: BigDecimalToString
classes.description: Converts BigDecimal to a locale-formatted string.

classes.name: BigIntegerToString
classes.description: Converts BigInteger to a locale-formatted string.

classes.name: ByteToString
classes.description: Converts Byte to a locale-formatted string.

classes.name: IntegerToString
classes.description: Converts Integer to String with locale formatting.

classes.name: LongToString
classes.description: Converts Long to String with locale formatting.

classes.name: ShortToString
classes.description: Converts Short to String with locale formatting.
